newsitem.title: CUBA: Cousteau was great 20th century explorer - Castro.
newsitem.headline: Cousteau was great 20th century explorer - Castro.

text.p: French oceanographer Jacques-Yves Cousteau was "one of the most notable naturalists and bravest explorers of our century," Cuban President Fidel Castro said in a condolence message to his family released on Thursday.

Cousteau, who died in Paris Wednesday aged 87, visited Cuba several times. He was "a dear and respected friend of our country and our people," Castro said in his message, an extract from which was published by the Communist Party newspaper Granma.
The Cuban leader, known to love the sea, said he would never forget the times when he had the "exceptional privilege" of sharing Cousteau's thoughts and deep concern about environmental issues.
